title: About Elzada Institute of Technology
content: Elzada Institute of Technology (EIT) is a premier engineering and management institution established in 2003 in Bengaluru, India. Spread across a 42-acre green campus, EIT is recognised by the AICTE, accredited with NAAC A++ and ranked among the top 50 private engineering colleges in India by the NIRF. The institute offers 28 undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programs across engineering, management, sciences, law and design, and is home to over 9,500 students and 480 full-time faculty members.

title: Vision, Mission and Values
content: Vision: To be a globally recognised institution producing socially responsible technologists and leaders. Mission: deliver outcome-based education, foster interdisciplinary research, and cultivate an entrepreneurial mindset. Core values: integrity, curiosity, inclusivity, sustainability, and excellence. The institute's pedagogy combines project-based learning, industry internships from the second year, and a mandatory social-impact capstone in the final year.

title: Leadership and Governance
content: EIT is governed by the Elzada Foundation, a not-for-profit public charitable trust. The Chairperson is Dr. Anita Rao, a former IIT Bombay professor. The Vice-Chancellor is Prof. Karthik Iyer, PhD (Stanford). The Academic Council includes distinguished academics from IISC, MIT and industry leaders from Infosys, TCS and Wipro. The institute publishes an annual Impact Report covering research output, placements and diversity metrics.

title: B.Tech Admissions 2025
content: B.Tech admissions at EIT are based on the Elzada Admission Test (EAT) or valid scores in JEE Main. Applications open on 1 November 2024 and close on 31 May 2025. The online EAT is conducted in two windows: 12-15 January 2025 and 6-9 April 2025. The application fee is INR 1,200 for general and INR 600 for SC/ST/PwD candidates. Candidates need a minimum 60% aggregate in Class XII (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics).

title: M.Tech Admissions
content: M.Tech admissions require a valid GATE score or an EIT-PG entrance test. Applicants must hold a B.E/B.Tech in the relevant discipline with at least 55% aggregate (50% for reserved categories). Sponsored candidates from industry with two years of work experience are also eligible. Applications close 30 June 2025. Scholarships of INR 12,400 per month are available for top GATE scorers.

title: MBA Admissions
content: The two-year full-time MBA admits students through CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT, GMAT or the EIT Management Aptitude Test (EMAT). Minimum requirement is a bachelor's degree with 50% aggregate. The selection process includes a personal interview and a written ability test. Application fee INR 1,500. Final deadline: 28 February 2025 for the 2025-27 batch.

title: International Admissions
content: International students can apply through the Elzada Global Admissions Portal. EIT accepts SAT, ACT, IB Diploma, A-Levels, and country-specific boards. Students must demonstrate English proficiency via IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 80, or PTE 58. The Office of International Affairs provides visa support, on-arrival orientation, and a one-semester foundation program in academic English for students needing additional preparation.

title: PhD Admissions
content: PhD admissions run twice a year, in January and July. Requirements include a master's degree with at least 60% aggregate (CGPA 6.0/10), a research proposal (1,500 words), and clearance of the EIT Research Aptitude Test (ERAT) followed by an interview. Full and partial research assistantships are available; assistantship amount is INR 31,000 per month for the first two years and INR 35,000 thereafter.

title: Important Dates and Deadlines
content: Key dates for 2025 admissions: Application opens 1 Nov 2024. EAT Round 1: 12-15 Jan 2025. EAT Round 2: 6-9 Apr 2025. Result declaration: 25 Jan and 20 Apr. Counselling: 1 Feb – 30 May. Classes commence 1 Aug 2025. MBA deadline: 28 Feb 2025. M.Tech deadline: 30 Jun 2025. PhD Jan cycle: 15 Dec 2024; July cycle: 15 May 2025.

title: B.Tech Programs Offered
content: EIT offers B.Tech programs in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, Mechanical, Civil, Biotechnology, Chemical, Aerospace, and Robotics. Each program is 4 years (8 semesters) with a flexible minor in management, sustainability or design. Students can also pursue a 5-year dual degree B.Tech + M.Tech.

title: M.Tech Specialisations
content: M.Tech specialisations include Structural Engineering, VLSI Design, Power Systems, Thermal Engineering, Computer Networks, Data Engineering, Robotics & Automation, AI & ML, Cybersecurity, and Biotechnology. Programs are 2 years with an industry thesis option. Sponsored seats (5 per department) are reserved for working professionals with a minimum of two years' experience.

title: MBA Specialisations
content: The MBA offers specialisations in Marketing, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, Business Analytics, IT & Systems, International Business, and a dual specialisation in FinTech. The flagship programme includes a 3-month industry internship, an international immersion module (Singapore / Dubai) and a live consulting capstone with partner companies.

title: Other Undergraduate Programs
content: Beyond B.Tech, EIT offers BBA (3 years), BCA (3 years), B.Des in Industrial Design and Communication Design (4 years), B.Pharm (4 years), BA LLB (5 years integrated), and BSc in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biotechnology (3 years). Lateral entry to B.Tech is available for diploma holders through the Lateral Entry Test (LET).

title: Fee Structure 2025-26
content: Annual tuition fees for Indian students for 2025-26: B.Tech INR 2,65,000; M.Tech INR 1,85,000; MBA INR 3,40,000; BBA/BCA INR 1,10,000; B.Des INR 1,95,000. Hostel + mess fee is INR 95,000 per year. International student tuition is USD 6,500 per year for B.Tech. Fees are reviewed annually and are inclusive of examination and library charges.

title: Scholarships and Financial Aid
content: Merit-cum-means scholarships: 100% tuition waiver for top 5% of admitted students (family income < INR 8 lakh). Sports scholarship up to INR 50,000 per year for national-level achievers. Girl-child scholarship of 25% tuition waiver for the first 100 B.Tech admissions. Defence quota (5%) with full tuition waiver for wards of armed forces personnel. Education loans are facilitated through SBI, HDFC Credila and the National Scholarship Portal.

title: Education Loans and EMI Options
content: EIT has tie-ups with SBI, Bank of Baroda, HDFC Credila, ICICI Bank and Axis Bank for collateral-free loans up to INR 20 lakh. The institute also offers an in-house 0% interest EMI option spread over 8 semesters for B.Tech students facing genuine financial difficulty, processed through the Student Welfare Office.

title: Placement Highlights 2023-24
content: EIT recorded its highest-ever placement season in 2023-24 with 96% of eligible students placed. The highest domestic CTC was INR 52 LPA (offered to a CSE student by Atlassian) and the highest international CTC was USD 145,000 (Microsoft, Redmond). Average CTC for B.Tech CSE was INR 14.2 LPA. Over 320 companies recruited from campus, including 28 new recruiters.

title: Top Recruiters
content: Top recruiters at EIT include Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Atlassian, Adobe, Salesforce, Uber, Flipkart, Razorpay, Zerodha, JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Deloitte, Accenture, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Qualcomm, Intel, NVIDIA, Texas Instruments, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz R&D, Tata Motors, Reliance Jio, Airtel, ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank and many more.

title: Internships and Industry Exposure
content: Every B.Tech student completes two internships: a 6-week exploratory internship after Year 2 and a 6-month thesis internship after Year 3. Internship stipend ranges from INR 15,000 to INR 1,00,000 per month. The Career Development Centre (CDC) conducts 1,200+ hours of soft-skills and aptitude training starting from Year 1.

title: Campus and Infrastructure
content: The 42-acre campus features academic blocks, 14 dedicated research centres, a central library with 1.8 lakh volumes and 22,000 e-journals, a 1,500-seat auditorium, an Olympic-length swimming pool, two indoor stadiums, eight hostels (4 boys, 3 girls, 1 international), 14 cafeterias, and 100% solar-powered common areas. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled with 12 Gbps backbone and 100% smart classrooms.

title: Hostel and Mess
content: EIT has 8 hostels housing over 6,000 students. Rooms are available in single, double and triple occupancy configurations, all with attached bathrooms, study desks, wardrobes and 24x7 power backup. The mess serves four meals a day with multi-cuisine options including North Indian, South Indian, Chinese and Continental. Special diet plans are available for athletes and medical requirements.

title: Laboratories and Research Centres
content: The institute runs 14 research centres: Centre for AI & Robotics, IoT & Embedded Systems, Advanced Materials, Sustainable Energy, Cybersecurity, Data Sciences, Bio-Innovation, Automotive Research, Aerospace, Structural Engineering, Smart Manufacturing, VLSI, Computational Linguistics, and Quantum Computing. All centres are open to undergraduates as research interns from Year 2.

title: Sports and Student Life
content: EIT offers 28 sports including cricket, football, basketball, tennis, swimming, athletics, kabaddi, kho-kho, chess, badminton, table tennis, yoga and esports. The annual cultural and technical fest 'Aavartan' draws 25,000+ visitors from 200 colleges. There are 80+ active student clubs ranging from robotics to filmmaking, debate, finance, social impact and astronomy.

title: Health, Safety and Wellbeing
content: The on-campus Health Centre operates 24x7 with two resident doctors, 12 nurses, an ambulance service, and a tie-up with Manipal Hospital for emergencies. Counselling services include 6 full-time psychologists and a peer-support network. The campus is secured with 200+ CCTV cameras, biometric access at hostels and academic blocks, and a dedicated women's safety cell.

content: Admissions Office: Elzada Institute of Technology, Survey No. 42, Devarabeesanahalli, Bengaluru – 560103, Karnataka, India. Phone: +91-80-4567-8900. Email: admissions@elzada.edu. Working hours: Mon-Sat, 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM IST. For international enquiries: global@elzada.edu, +91-80-4567-8950.

title: Visit the Campus
content: Prospective students and parents are welcome to schedule a campus tour any working day (Mon-Sat) between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM. Tours are guided by senior student ambassadors and cover academic blocks, hostels, research labs, the library, and sports facilities. Bookings can be made through the campus visit form or by calling +91-80-4567-8900.

title: Elzada as a Deemed University
content: EIT was conferred deemed-to-be-university status by the UGC in 2009 and is authorised to award its own degrees. It is a member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) and is recognised by international bodies including WES, AACSB and ABET-equivalent accreditation for engineering programs.

title: Academic Calendar and Structure
content: The academic year runs from August to June with two semesters. Each semester has 90 instructional days, two internal assessments and an end-semester examination. The Choice-Based Credit System (CBCS) allows students to pick electives across departments. The grading scale is a 10-point CGPA with a minimum 5.0 to pass and 7.5 to earn distinction.

title: Research and Publications
content: EIT publishes over 850 peer-reviewed papers annually and has filed 120+ patents since 2018 (32 granted). Faculty members have received funding from DST, SERB, DBT, ISRO, MHRD and global agencies including the European Commission and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Undergraduate research is supported through the UGRIP (Undergraduate Research Internship Program) with a stipend of INR 10,000 per month.

title: Industry-Aligned Curriculum
content: All B.Tech curricula are co-designed with industry partners (e.g., AWS Academy, Cisco Networking Academy, SAP University Alliances, NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute). Students earn at least two industry certifications as part of the program. Curriculum is reviewed annually with an industry advisory board comprising leaders from Microsoft, Google, Tata Consultancy Services and Bosch.

title: Honors and Minors
content: Students with a CGPA of 8.0+ can pursue Department Honors by completing 12 extra credits of advanced coursework and a research thesis. Minors are available in Management, Sustainability, Design Thinking, Data Analytics, Robotics, Linguistics and Public Policy. Both Honors and Minors are reflected on the final transcript.

title: Reservation Policy
content: EIT follows the Government of India reservation policy: 15% SC, 7.5% ST, 27% OBC (non-creamy layer), 10% EWS. 5% horizontal reservation is provided for PwD candidates. Supernumerary seats (10%) are reserved for Kashmiri migrants and wards of defence personnel. Candidates claiming reserved category must produce valid central / state government-issued certificates at the time of counselling.

title: Cancellation and Refund Policy
content: Candidates may cancel their admission before the academic session begins and receive a full refund of tuition fees minus a processing charge of INR 5,000. After the session begins, refund is prorated as per UGC norms. Hostel fees are refunded on a semester basis. Refunds are processed within 21 working days through the original mode of payment.

title: Alumni Network
content: The Elzada Alumni Network (ELAN) has 38,000+ members across 65 countries. Notable alumni include Rajeev Bhatt (Founder, FinNova), Anjali Iyer (CTO, Stripe India), Vikram Naidu (Director of Engineering, Google), and Priya Sharma (Partner, Sequoia Capital). Alumni mentor current students through the 'Bridge' program and contribute to capstone projects.

title: Transportation
content: EIT operates 35 shuttle buses covering all major routes in Bengaluru including Whitefield, Electronic City, Hebbal, Yelahanka, JP Nagar and Kempegowda International Airport. The campus is also accessible via the upcoming Nagavara Metro station (1.4 km) and is 32 km from the airport. Free bicycle sharing is available inside the campus.

title: Sustainability Initiatives
content: EIT is a signatory of the UN PRME (Principles for Responsible Management Education) and has committed to net-zero campus operations by 2030. Current initiatives include a 2.4 MW rooftop solar plant, rainwater harvesting covering 100% of the campus, a zero-single-use-plastic policy, an on-campus 1,000 sqm organic farm, and a Centre for Sustainable Development.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
content: Q: Is EIT approved by AICTE? Yes, all programs are AICTE-approved. Q: What is the medium of instruction? English for all programs. Q: Are there hostel facilities for first-year students? Yes, hostel allocation is guaranteed. Q: Can I change my branch after first year? Yes, based on merit and seat availability. Q: Is there a dress code? No formal dress code, although lab-appropriate attire is required in laboratories.
